answer: The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in grove, expire in island, and nadir lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 186 aliases therefore needs 43 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4003 identities would post 1724 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
